flagged.evidence: The Definition says to apply the composite midpoint rule "on a partition of [0,A]" and set each mass to Δa n₀(aᵢ), without requiring equal cell widths. The current supplier alg-composite-midpoint-rule sets h=(b−a)/n and uses nodes a+(j+1/2)h, so it requires a uniform grid. On a nonuniform partition there is no single Δa for these weights, and the called procedure does not apply as written.

The current contract quote says the inputs already satisfy a<b and n≥1, then describes an invalid-grid return. The current alg-composite-midpoint-rule instead takes raw endpoints and n, returns invalid-grid before evaluating f when a≥b or n<1, and only then requires f for valid grids. Thus the quoted F1 is not the current Definition. The item proof uses valid positive-width cells with n=1, so this quote defect does not invalidate its estimate.
